_meta.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#000.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#001.src: Oh, ho ho. What is this? A Human? What brings you to Gylia Watch - want to let your hair down a bit, I bet!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#001.dst: おやおや。何だこれは？人間か？Gylia Watch に何の用だ――羽を伸ばしに来たんだろ、そうだろ！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#001.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#001.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.src: Of course you know who we are! The Gylia Watch was founded over {~} years ago in wake of the Villager victory in the war.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.dst: もちろん俺たちのことは知ってるよな！Gylia Watch は戦争で村人が勝った後、{~} 年以上前に設立されたんだ。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.src: The Gerten war! Only the most famous war in all of modern Gavel! The might of the Villagers crushed those blasted Gerts - not that they were particularly hard to beat, heh.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.dst: Gert 戦争だよ！現代 Gavel で一番有名な戦争だ！村人の力があの忌々しい Gert どもを叩き潰した――まあ、大して手強くもなかったがな、へへ。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.src: Gerts are stupid brutes, you see. The only thing they ever think about is food.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.dst: Gert ってのは馬鹿な獣みたいな連中でな。頭の中は食い物のことだけだ。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.src: Get too close to one and it'll chomp your fingers off, quick as you like. And then the rest of you as well!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.dst: 近づきすぎりゃ、あっという間に指を食いちぎられる。そのあと残りの全身もな！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.src: The peace treaty keeps them inside their borders, and we get a delivery of supplies every month from {p} to send over to them.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.dst: 和平条約で奴らは国境の内側に閉じ込めてある。で、毎月 {p} から物資が届くから、それを奴らに送るってわけだ。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.src: Of course, we have to keep some of the supplies for ourselves - you've seen how hard these men are working, they deserve a bit of a party!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.dst: もちろん、物資の一部は俺たち用に取っとかなきゃな――皆の働きっぷりを見ただろ、ちょっとした宴会くらい当然さ！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.src: The Watch keeps a lookout over the Gerten borders day and night... well, maybe not on poker nights!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.dst: Watch は昼も夜も Gert の国境を見張ってる…まあ、ポーカーの夜は別かもな！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.src: Although... we have heard a couple of nasty rumors floating about - farmers disappearing from their houses and the such.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.dst: とはいえ…ちょいと嫌な噂が流れててな――農夫が家から消えたとか、そういう話だ。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.src: If I really can't tempt you with a glass of wine and a round of poker, maybe you could go and check them out for us?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.dst: ワイン一杯とポーカー一勝負で釣れないなら、代わりに様子を見てきてくれないか？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.src: I'd send the men, but... well, I'd feel bad if one of them went and missed all the partying!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.dst: 部下を行かせてもいいんだが…宴会を丸ごと逃す奴が出たら気の毒だろ！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.src: Here, you should head over and talk to Jitak, they're one of the farmers that lodged a complaint. Their house is west of here, I'll write down the co-ordinates.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.dst: ほら、Jitak と話してこい、苦情を出した農夫の一人だ。家はここから西だ、座標を書いといてやる。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#014.src: If you are looking for a suit or something, I can't help you. Now is a very bad time.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#014.dst: スーツか何かを探しに来たなら、力になれない。今はとても間が悪いんだ。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#014.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#014.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.src: Oh, you're here on behalf of the Watch? Ha, even sending Humans to do their work is not beneath them.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.dst: え、Watch の使いで来た？はっ、人間に仕事をやらせるのも平気なんだな。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.src: All they do is sit up in that tower playing drinking games and act like they own this region!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.dst: 奴らは塔にこもって飲み比べばかりして、この地域を我が物顔で仕切ってる！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.src: I reported the fact there is clearly a Gert camp right in front of my house and they just ignored me! Now look, my pigs are all gone!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.dst: 家のすぐ前に Gert の野営地があるって報告したのに無視された！見てくれ、豚が全部いなくなった！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.src: I knew it was a mistake getting this property so close to gerten borders. See, gerts aren't the 'brutes' people insist, but...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.dst: Gert の国境にこんなに近い土地を買ったのが間違いだった。Gert は皆が言うような「獣」じゃない、でも…
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.src: Well, they'll eat anything! Animals, fish, monsters, villagers, even humans! Biologically, they're just constantly hungry.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.dst: 何でも食べるんだ！動物、魚、魔物、村人、人間まで！生物学的に、常に腹を空かせてるんだよ。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.src: The watch is meant to keep them behind their borders...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.dst: Watch は奴らを国境の向こうに留めるためにあるはずなのに…
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.src: I even bought a golem to watch over them - Got it for a good price because of some incident down at the {p} factory.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.dst: 見張りにゴーレムまで買ったんだ――{p} の工場で何か事故があったとかで安く手に入った。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.src: But somehow the gerts are managing to avoid it! Look, if you're here from the watch, could you help me out?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.dst: なのに Gert はなぜかそれを避けてる！なあ、Watch から来たなら手伝ってくれないか？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.src: Go to the gert camp west of here and find out how they are doing all of this!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.dst: ここから西の Gert の野営地へ行って、どうやってるのか突き止めてくれ！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.src: Inspect the Gerten Forwarding Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Gert 前線野営地を調べる。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.src: Investigate the cave in the back of the camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の野営地奥の洞窟を調べる。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#026.dst: Gert の洞窟を探索する。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#026.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.src: -Good job to all of you! I am proud to say we made the cave road very well.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.dst: ――みんな、よくやった！洞窟の道、とてもよく作れた、ほこらしい。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.src: The town folk at Gylia steal the stuff meant for us for their party, and leave us high and dry!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.dst: Gylia の町の者、おれたちの物をうたげに使うため盗む、おれたち何もない！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.src: But those dumb over fed town folk did not catch us when we dug our cave road right under their watch house.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.dst: でもあの食べすぎのばかな町の者、おれたちが見張り小屋の真下に洞窟の道をほったとき、気づかなかった。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.src: With our new way to get to Gylia land we have more stuff than ever!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.dst: Gylia の土地への新しい道で、物が今までより多い！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Jitak のもとへ戻る。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.src: Human! You're back... and haven't been eaten by a Gert!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.dst: 人間！戻ったか…Gert に食べられずに！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.src: What did you discover in the camp?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.dst: 野営地で何を見つけた？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.src: A tunnel?! Past Gerten borders? That must be how they're managing to get in and steal my livestock.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.dst: トンネル？！国境の向こうまで？それで入り込んで家畜を盗んでたのか。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.src: Look, human. The Watch aren't gonna do anything about this. Please... maybe you can help me.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.dst: なあ人間。Watch はこの件で何もしない。頼む…君なら助けられるかも。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.src: If you can disguise yourself as a Gert maybe you could sneak into their main camp and check out this tunnel?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.dst: Gert に変装できれば、奴らの本陣に忍び込んでそのトンネルを調べられるんじゃないか？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.src: Okay! As you can see, all Gerts wear a carved pumpkin on their head - something to do with their culture.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.dst: よし！見ての通り、Gert はみんな頭に彫ったカボチャをかぶってる――文化的なものらしい。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.src: There's a pumpkin farm near here at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]... maybe you could get one from there?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.dst: この近くの [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にカボチャ畑がある…そこで手に入らないか？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.src: Go to the gerten pumpkin farm at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Gert のカボチャ畑へ行く。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.src: Oh good, were you sent here to be my lunch?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.dst: おお、いいぞ、おれの昼ごはんとして来たのか？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.src: Are you here to be my lunch?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.dst: おれの昼ごはんになりに来た？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.src: Oh. What are you then, some kind of snack?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.dst: おお。じゃあおまえ何だ、おやつか？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.src: ... Is that a joke? What are you, some kind of snack?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.dst: …それ冗談？おまえ何だ、おやつか？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.src: A who.. man? Oh, you mean new folk! All the way here in gerten lands? I have not seen one of you here.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.dst: ひゅー…まん？ああ、新しい人のことか！Gert の土地まで来たのか？ここで見たことない。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.src: I do want to know how you taste...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.dst: おまえの味、知りたいな…
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.src: Doing? I am here to guard the orange gourd farm, of course!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.dst: 何してるか？もちろんオレンジのウリ畑の見張りだ！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.src: This farm right here is where all the gerts get their day mask from!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.dst: この畑で、Gert みんな昼の顔をもらうんだ！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.src: No, new folk. Gerts only in this farm.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.dst: だめ、新しい人。この畑 Gert だけ。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.src: That is why I am put here. To make sure no one gets in.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.dst: だからおれがここにいる。だれも入れないように。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.src: But but I get so bored... and I really want to eat...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.dst: でもでも、すごくひまで…すごく食べたい…
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.src: Like, with the clear green rocks?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.dst: えっと、すきとおった緑の石で？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.src: No new folk, gerts do not have any need for green rocks. But...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.dst: いらない新しい人、Gert に緑の石いらない。でも…
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.src: How about this - I will just eat you!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.dst: こうしよう――おまえを食べる！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#058.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#058.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#059.src: Well, I think I will still eat you. Just how it is!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#059.dst: うーん、やっぱりおまえ食べる。そういうものだ！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#059.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#059.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.src: Oh, it is a thing gerts have been doing for as long as we know.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.dst: おお、Gert がずっと昔からやってること。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.src: At wake time each day a gert takes an orange gourd and eats into it a shape that shows their mood!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.dst: 毎日起きたら、Gert はオレンジのウリをとって、気分を表す形にかじるんだ！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.src: It is really nice, is it not?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.src: We all want to eat all the time!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.dst: おれたちずっと食べたい！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.src: Oh... goodbye. Come back soon? With some food?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.dst: おお…さよなら。すぐ戻る？食べ物持って？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.src: Find a way to distract the Gert Guard with some food nearby.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.dst: 近くの食べ物で Gert の見張りの気をそらす方法を探す。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#067.src: Oh man, a red tree fruit! I should not leave my post... but I want to eat...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#067.dst: わあ、赤い木の実！持ち場を離れちゃだめ…でも食べたい…
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#067.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#067.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#068.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#068.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#069.src: It is only a few steps that way...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#069.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#069.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#070.src: That tastes so good! What a good red tree fruit.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#070.dst: おいしい！いい赤い木の実だ。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#070.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#070.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#071.src: ... If I wait here, more might fall from the sky!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#071.dst: …ここで待ったら、空からもっと落ちてくるかも！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#071.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#071.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#072.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#073.src: Find a pumpkin to use as a gert mask.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#073.dst: Gert の仮面にするカボチャを探す。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#073.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#074.src: Hey! What're you doing in the pumpkin farm at this hour?
